## Linked Issue

Feel free to link the issue this PR addresses if one exists. Small fixes and improvements don't need an issue first.

## Before you submit

- If this change affects users (new CLI flag, MCP tool parameter, or behavior change), add an entry under `[Unreleased]` in `CHANGELOG.md`.
- If you've added or changed a CLI flag or MCP tool parameter, update the reference docs under `docs/`.
